question: Roughly how many hairs grow on an adult human scalp, in thousands?
move: Split the unknown into two things you can guess, then multiply.
trap: Guessing a round million because hair feels endless.
hint: Treat the scalp as a patch of skin and count hairs per square centimetre.
steps: A scalp covers roughly 600 square centimetres.
Hair density there is roughly 170 hairs per square centimetre.
reference: Robbins, Chemical and Physical Behavior of Human Hair, 5th edition, Springer, 2012
